# 📋What is this Mod

**FRK's Ancient Armors** The mod adds mystical weapons compatible with armor sets in the Ancient Armors collection. Each weapon has its own unique powers and story. All weapons are craftable and can be used seamlessly.

# ⚔️Weapons

## Wither Bone Spear

Crafted from the remains of a Wither skeleton, this weapon emits a Wither effect on your enemies.

Rarity = Epic

## Warrior Weapon

Powerful, perhaps a little slow, but for the best warriors.

Rarity = Uncommon

## Ancient Guardian Axe

This axe was found among the wood the old sorcerer had cut; a powerful, custom axe inspired by a guardian.

Rarity = Mystic

## Old Wizard Stick

A legendary stick found in an old wizard's weaponroom.

Rarity = Legendary

## Cursed Knight Sword

Maybe for you, maybe for your damnation

Rarity = Mystic

## Lord Of Monsters Sword

Spread your splendor everywhere.

Rarity = Legendary
